baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated verbs يُجَٰدِلُ and يَتَّبِعُ, with بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ between them.
baseline_models.mechanism: A verbal contest twists assertion against assertion while excluding disclosed knowledge and its distinguishing marks. The same subject then follows rather than verifies; كُلَّ makes that receptivity exhaustive, and شَيْطَٰنٍ مَّرِيدٍ identifies the followed sources as rebellious and stripped of good.

activation_trace.role: Entwined verbal contest supplies speech that loops against an opponent and functions as the subject's apparent epistemic activity.
Exclusion and negation make knowledge absent from the contest rather than merely incomplete.
Disclosure to a knower is the missing constraint that could test the contest's claims.
Following behind and imitating turns the subject's supposedly active dispute into derivative conduct.
Comprehensive inclusion makes the following indiscriminate across every available rebellious source.
The overbearing rebel supplies the class of agents whose direction substitutes for knowledge.
Being stripped of good until hardened in rebellion intensifies the followed source's settled resistance.

changed_reading.before: An uninformed person argues about God and also imitates devils.
changed_reading.after: The argument is part of the following mechanism: with knowledge excluded, rival verbal pressure becomes direction, so the apparent independent disputant is comprehensively derivative.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يُجَٰدِلُ ... يَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَٰنٍ links roots whose inventories include twisting, trailing, long cord, distance, and encirclement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The contest can be modeled materially as a tightly braided tether. Following moves along that tether after distant forces; totality turns one cord into an encircling system, while the smooth or stripped quality of مَرِيد suggests reduced grip for resistance.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies the braid and functions as the material organization of the dispute.
Trailing behind supplies motion along the braided line rather than autonomous route choice.
A long strongly twisted cord makes the tether image internal to the focus root inventory.
Distance and severance supply the trajectory toward remoteness.
Something surrounding like a crown turns plural susceptibility into encirclement.
A polished smooth surface supplies a low-friction quality to the tether's rebellious guide.

changed_reading.before: Debating and following are two adjacent bad actions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, argumentative braiding makes the very tether by which the subject is drawn after increasingly remote influences; speaking and capture are one material circuit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ, بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ, and يَتَّبِعُ attach human perception and sociability to absent marks and stepwise pursuit.
baseline_models.mechanism: The human root inventory carries seeing, sensing, hearing, and companionship. Knowledge can be a mark that distinguishes and guides, yet here that mark is absent; the human capacity to perceive and find company inverts into tracing alienating influences step after step.

activation_trace.role: Perceiving by sight, sensation, or hearing supplies the human faculty that should register evidence.
Companionship that removes estrangement supplies the social pull that is being redirected.
A distinguishing mark that guides is precisely what the construction says the subject lacks.
Tracing one mark after another supplies a failed search procedure captured by the wrong trail.
Distance and severance make the resulting companionship alienating rather than familiarizing.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies a morally bad member of humanity.
changed_reading.after: It depicts an inversion of human capacities: perception without a reliable mark and sociability without discernment become stepwise attachment to what increases distance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root ت ب ع in يَتَّبِعُ carries both pursuit of a claim and a consequence that remains attached.
baseline_models.mechanism: Following can establish more than imitation: it can bring a claimant and an attached consequence behind the follower. كُلَّ multiplies those claims, while the surrounding dispute gives the relation a contested, consequential field.

activation_trace.role: Pursuit of a right or claim supplies a claimant-like relation inside following.
An attached liability supplies the consequence that trails the follower.
Comprehensive totality multiplies the attached claims across every followed source.
Contested speech supplies the arena in which allegiance appears cost-free while accruing consequences.

changed_reading.before: Following means copying a rebellious leader.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each allegiance creates a trailing claim: the follower accumulates the liabilities of every direction he adopts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two preceding ayat stage violent shaking, failed attention to a nursing bond, release of every pregnancy, and people who look intoxicated without intoxicant. The focus subject's no-knowledge argument and exhaustive following can therefore be read as a disoriented response inside a field where perception and primary attachments have come loose.

activation_trace.role: Human sensing and seeing anchor the changed reading in the focus subject's perceptual capacity.
Missing disclosure names the focus failure produced within the surrounding perceptual crisis.
Violent disturbance supplies the environmental unsteadiness that precedes the focus conduct.
Attention departing from its object supplies cognitive unfastening.
A nursing relation equivalent to kinship supplies the primary attachment from which attention is torn.
The inner carried burden being released supplies bodily loss of containment.
Loss of sobriety or its likeness supplies impaired appearance while the explicit negation prevents a simple substance explanation.
Repeated comprehensive totality anticipates the focus ayah's كُلَّ and transfers universal disruption into universal susceptibility.

structural_cues: 22:1-2 immediately precede the focus ayah.
22:2 repeats both الناس and كل before 22:3 repeats them in a new behavioral configuration.
The contrast سكارى وما هم بسكارى distinguishes disoriented appearance from literal intoxication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies environmental shaking, severed attention, released burdens, and altered appearance; I infer that 22:3 presents one epistemic-social response under that pressure. A live alternative is that 22:1-2 remain only eschatological background and do not causally profile the disputant.

changed_reading.before: The disputant calmly chooses bad argument and bad company.
changed_reading.after: The disputant is also a figure of unmoored perception: under total destabilization, lost epistemic grip is converted into indiscriminate attachment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel gives following a rule-like trajectory: a consequence is written upon the rebellious agent, and whoever enters his patronal proximity is misdirected and then 'guided' toward punishment. Following thus transfers practical direction to a guide whose route is already fixed.

activation_trace.role: Following behind anchors the transfer of route control in the focus verb.
The rebellious agent supplies the immediate antecedent whose governing effect the sequel unfolds.
An established writing that obliges a judgment supplies the fixed consequence of the relation.
Taking charge of an affair supplies the patronal transfer embedded in تولاه.
Departure from guidance and intended direction supplies the first leg of the assigned route.
Gentle direction toward a road is used with an adverse destination, exposing guidance as a formally neutral directional capacity.

structural_cues: 22:4 is the immediate syntactic sequel to the focus ayah.
Singular pronouns carry forward the shaytan-follower relation.
The paired verbs يضله ويهديه specify process and destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an obligatory writing, patronal proximity, misdirection, and directed arrival; I infer that following delegates practical guidance. A live alternative is that تولاه foregrounds the human's chosen allegiance more than the shaytan's acquired control.

changed_reading.before: The person copies a rebel's behavior.
changed_reading.after: The person appoints a directional patron and enters a preassigned itinerary: allegiance hands over route selection, including the route's destructive destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-verbatim recurrence in 22:8 expands بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ into a threefold lack: knowledge, guidance, and an illuminating book. The next ayah embodies that lack as a turned side and gives it a social vector, misleading others from a path. Ignorance becomes active refusal of orienting media, not a passive information gap.

activation_trace.role: The absent distinguishing mark anchors the expanded evidence deficit in the focus phrase.
The repeated entwined verbal contest identifies the later figure with the focus behavior.
Repeated absence of disclosed knowledge forms the first missing guide.
Direction toward road and truth forms the second missing guide.
Ordered writing forms the durable third medium that the disputant lacks.
Illumination makes the book an exposing guide rather than inert text.
Turning the side in refusal gives bodily form to rejection of the three guides.
Causing departure from intended direction turns private lack into transmitted misguidance.
The extended traversable road supplies the orientation from which others are diverted.

structural_cues: 22:8 repeats the focus clause through بغير علم and then adds two coordinated negations.
22:9 continues the same singular figure with a body posture and causative misguidance.
The sequence moves from absent cognition to bodily orientation to social effect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated clause, a stacked evidence deficit, bodily turning, and causative diversion; I infer that the deficit has become active refusal and exportable direction. A live alternative is that the posture chiefly marks arrogance while the intent to mislead is an additional vice rather than the mechanism of the original dispute.

changed_reading.before: Without knowledge means simply not possessing enough facts.
changed_reading.after: It names a collapsed orientation stack: no disclosed recognition, no living direction, and no illuminating record; dispute fills the vacuum and turns that refusal outward onto others.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:46 relocates blindness from eyes to hearts within chests and pairs hearts that restrain ignorance with ears that understand and comply. The focus lack of knowledge is therefore not explained by unavailable signs alone; it can be an embodied interpretive organ failing to let perception constrain desire and action.

activation_trace.role: Human seeing, sensing, and hearing anchor the later organ contrast in the focus designation.
Absent disclosure is recast as failure of reception rather than mere scarcity of information.
The heart supplies the named inner organ that can reason or become blind.
Reason as a restraint from ignorance supplies the heart's required checking function.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes reception behavioral rather than merely acoustic.
Blindness of heart and insight supplies the explicit diagnosis of inner nonrecognition.
Ordinary eyesight supplies the intact faculty contrasted with inner blindness.
The chest as source from which acts issue locates epistemic failure upstream of conduct.

structural_cues: The contrast explicitly negates blindness of the eyes and affirms blindness of hearts.
Travel through the land is linked by purpose to acquiring reasoning hearts and hearing ears.
The focus ayah already coordinates deficient knowing with following behavior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intact eyes, blind hearts, reasoning as restraint, and hearing as compliance; I infer that the focus disputant's lack is a failed constraint between perception and action. A live alternative is that travel is illustrative evidence gathering and not a general anatomy of every no-knowledge dispute.

changed_reading.after: The deeper failure is internal uptake: available sights and sounds do not become heart-level restraint, so argument can coexist with abundant evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:52-54 presents an adversarial information process: shaytan casts into an aspiration or recitative channel, God removes what is cast and consolidates the signs, and the same event separates diseased or hardened hearts from those given knowledge whose hearts settle. The focus person's following can thus occur at the uptake stage, before injected material is distinguished from what has been made firm.

activation_trace.role: Tracing an item step by step anchors following as an uptake process rather than only social allegiance.
The rebellious agent recurs as the explicit source of inserted material.
Recitation placed in its positions supplies a live channel reading alongside the branch's broader field of inward aspiration.
Casting something down supplies the injection operation.
Removal followed by replacement supplies active deletion of the injected material.
Making firm and tightly ordered supplies consolidation of the signs after deletion.
Testing metal or person supplies the sorting function assigned to the insertion event.
Loss of heart-softness supplies one receiver condition under which the insertion becomes a trial.
Disclosure to those given knowledge supplies successful discrimination of the consolidated truth.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what knowledgeable receivers recognize.
A low, calm, open tract supplies the heart's settled receptive posture after recognition.
Direction toward road and truth supplies the successful output of the filtering process.

structural_cues: 22:52 gives an ordered cast-remove-firm sequence.
22:53-54 assign opposed receiver outcomes to the same event.
The focus roots ش ط ن and ع ل م recur on opposite sides of the filtering process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a casting source, deletion, consolidation, testing, and opposed heart responses; I infer an adversarial insertion-and-filter mechanism and place focus following at uncritical uptake. A live alternative is that تمنى foregrounds aspiration rather than recitation, but either scope still retains insertion into a humanly active channel followed by correction.

changed_reading.before: Following a shaytan means knowingly choosing an obviously rebellious leader.
changed_reading.after: Following can be epistemically subtle: an alien contribution enters an active channel, and the decisive failure is accepting it before truth is distinguished and made firm by knowledge and a receptive heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:67-70 places ritual plurality beside mutual pulling and renewed jidal, then answers with invitation from straight guidance, acknowledgment that God knows deeds, divine judgment over difference, and a comprehensive book. The focus fault is not speech as such but using argumentative braiding to seize adjudicative authority while lacking the knowledge and record that could sustain it.

activation_trace.role: Tight verbal braiding anchors the counterbraiding that the later response declines to continue.
Distinct worship practice supplies the concrete domain in which contest arises.
Mutual pulling between sides supplies a force model for the dispute.
Direction toward truth supplies the speaker's warranted location without requiring argumentative ownership of judgment.
Straightness and balance qualify that guidance as an aligned route.
The focus contest recurs explicitly, allowing the prescribed response to revise the baseline.
Divine knowing of deeds supplies the knowledge claim to which the dispute is deferred.
Judgment between people supplies adjudication outside the disputants' verbal contest.
Each side taking a different road supplies the live plurality that judgment will separate.
The written record supplies durable total context unavailable to the no-knowledge disputant.

structural_cues: 22:67-70 forms a continuous sequence from ritual difference to dispute, response, judgment, knowledge, and record.
The response in 22:68 is brief rather than a mirrored counterargument.
God's knowledge and judgment repeatedly occupy roles the disputants might claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ritual difference, mutual pulling, straight guidance, a restrained reply, judgment, and record; I infer a discipline of refusing adjudicative capture by debate. A live alternative is that الله أعلم is reassurance about outcome rather than a general rhetorical method.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns argument about God categorically.
changed_reading.after: It condemns argument that usurps judgment without epistemic standing; the alternative is to remain on disclosed direction, invite, and leave final separation to knowledge and judgment larger than the contest.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:71-73 links worship without revealed authority or knowledge to hostile facial recognition of clear signs, near assault on their reciters, and a parable in which called objects cannot recover a tiny loss and both seeker and sought are weak. The focus dispute can function as compensatory defense around a powerless dependency relation whose claimant and liability cannot deliver protection.

activation_trace.role: Pursuit and demand for a claim anchor the later seeker-sought relation in the focus following.
Attached liability supplies the cost hidden inside the dependency.
A compelling proof or authority is explicitly absent from the worship relation.
The repeated absence of disclosed knowledge directly recalls the focus deficit.
Visible signs supply the evidence against which the dependency is defensively maintained.
Recognition by a trace or mark shows that the signs register even as they are rejected.
Denial as the opposite of recognition supplies the hostile conversion of perceived evidence.
Near enactment supplies the transition from facial rejection toward assault.
Calling and drawing by speech supplies the dependency's appeal toward the followed object.
Failed extraction from another's grasp supplies the followed object's inability to protect or recover.
The opposite of strength supplies the shared condition of both sides of the relation.
Seeking and the thing sought form the paired dependency whose two poles are declared weak.

structural_cues: 22:71 repeats the no-knowledge formula while adding absent revealed authority.
22:72 moves from clear recitation to visible denial and near physical assault.
22:73 ends with the balanced active-passive pair الطالب والمطلوب after a failed recovery scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unsupported worship, registered yet rejected signs, near aggression, failed recovery, and a weak seeker-sought pair; I infer that dispute defends a dependency whose object cannot secure it. A live alternative is that 22:71-73 addresses called objects broadly, so its application to every focus shaytan is analogical rather than referentially identical.

changed_reading.before: The follower is weak because a stronger rebel dominates him.
changed_reading.after: Follower and followed can form a jointly weak dependency: because the object cannot protect or recover, argument and aggression compensate for the relation's lack of authority and efficacy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah closes by denying constrictive entanglement in religion, commanding a protective holdfast to God, and naming one patron and helper. This revises the tether baseline: the alternative to following every long-cord rebel is not unattached autonomy, but a nonproliferating attachment whose function is preservation rather than dispersal.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting anchors the focus's proliferating material entanglement.
The long strongly twisted cord supplies the adverse tether contrasted with the closing holdfast.
Every and whole supplies proliferating allegiance across all adverse tethers.
Gathering and entanglement supply the constrictive condition explicitly denied in the religious path.
The worshiped object is also the explicit object of protective holding, unifying direction and attachment.
A strap or fastening grasped for support supplies the alternative tether whose purpose is protection.
Love, aid, and patronage name the single legitimate relational center.
Aid that makes one prevail supplies the holdfast's protective outcome.

structural_cues: 22:78 is the surah's closing ayah.
The command واعتصموا بالله is immediately followed by هو مولاكم and paired praise of patron and helper.
The focus has one follower distributed across كل شيطان, whereas the closure gives one object of holding and one patron.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus cord branches, denied constriction, protective fastening, one patron, and aid; I infer two competing attachment regimes. A live alternative is that اعتصام denotes protective adherence without activating a material cord image.

changed_reading.before: The problem is attachment itself, so freedom would mean following no one.
changed_reading.after: The problem is dispersed, nonprotective attachment to every remote force; the closure answers with one protective holdfast and one patron that preserves agency by orienting it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-activates literal cord branches rather than the ordinary abstract senses of dispute and shaytan. It remains anchored in the focus's tight twisting, long cord, and following roots, while 22:15 supplies extension, a cord-connection, cutting, stratagem, and inward rage. Downstream prose should present it only as a material systems analogy, not as a lexical translation of either ayah or a claim about the scene's historical procedure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ج د ل B001, ت ب ع B001, and ش ط ن B002 jointly expose a braided cord along which following can move.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies the argumentative braid.
Following behind supplies travel of influence along the braid.
The long strongly twisted cord makes the material cross-activation packet-internal.
Drawing something lengthwise until connected supplies cord extension.
A cord and connection supplies the explicit material link.
Severing supplies the attempted interruption of the circuit.
Stratagem supplies the engineered attempt to control the tether's outcome.
Constricted rage in the chest supplies the pressure that remains after the attempted cut.

changed_reading.before: The disputant uses argument, then separately follows a shaytan.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material analogy, argument braids and extends the adverse connection; reactive attempts to manipulate or cut that circuit do not by themselves remove the inward pressure that powers it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because 22:31 describes a falling associator, not the focus disputant, and maps plural following onto a spatial dynamics scene. It remains validly anchored in كُلَّ, following, and the shaytan branch of distance; the context supplies falling, snatching, airborne force, and a remote endpoint. Downstream prose should mark it as an analogy for distributed agency loss, not identify the bird or wind with a shaytan.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَٰنٍ combines trailing, exhaustive plurality, and distance.

activation_trace.role: Trailing supplies motion governed by what is ahead.
Exhaustive inclusion supplies multiple simultaneous candidate vectors.
Distance and severance supply the vectors' common outward result.
Noisy unstable falling supplies initial loss of self-directed footing.
Swift snatching supplies capture by an external vector.
Released rash motion supplies one unpredictable carrier.
Descent into an abyss supplies irreversible downward displacement.
Wind as force and dominance supplies a second impersonal carrier.
Extreme distance supplies the endpoint shared by competing vectors.

changed_reading.before: Following every shaytan means repeatedly choosing many bad leaders.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, 'every' depicts distributed capture: competing external vectors do not enlarge choice but abolish a stable trajectory, carrying the subject toward a shared remoteness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most branch-distant reading: it activates مَرِيد through its polished-building branch and places it beside 22:45's ruined settlement, disabled well, and raised plastered palace. It remains anchored because the focus also lacks the distinguishing mark carried by ع ل م, so smoothness can function as a surface resistant to diagnostic grip. Downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for persuasive facade, never as the lexical meaning of مريد in the focus.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَّرِيدٍ B002 supplies a polished smooth structure, while بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ lacks the mark by which a surface could be diagnostically distinguished.

activation_trace.role: A tall polished smooth structure supplies the seductive low-grip facade.
The absent distinguishing mark supplies inability to diagnose the polished surface.
Vacancy and emptiness supply the condition hidden behind impressive elevation.
The well supplies essential life-supporting infrastructure.
Emptied disuse supplies failure of that infrastructure.
An enclosed monumental building supplies the surviving facade.
Raised and plaster-strengthened construction supplies the facade's conspicuous finish.

changed_reading.before: Mārid only intensifies the shaytan's moral rebellion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the followed rebel can also present as a polished explanatory facade: smooth argumentative elevation remains impressive while the underlying well of knowledge and inhabitable order is empty.

strongest_changes: The immediate sequel turns following into delegated guidance under a written adverse trajectory.
The repeated dispute formula expands no knowledge into absence of knowledge, guidance, and illuminating record, then gives that refusal bodily and social direction.
The heart-blindness passage relocates the failure from unavailable evidence to failed embodied uptake.
The cast-remove-firm sequence makes satanic following an adversarial insertion and receiver-filter problem.
The closing holdfast contrasts dispersed attachment to every remote force with one protective patronal attachment.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence preserved explicit epistemic mechanisms while activating unusually coherent material ones: braid, cord, cutting, distributed falling, and polished facade all remained anchored in focus roots rather than becoming independent themes.
remaining_uncertainties: The coordination of يجادل and يتبع supports one mechanism but does not grammatically prove that argument causes following rather than accompanying it.
The agency and emphasis within تولاه can be distributed differently between chosen allegiance and acquired patronal control.
The scope of تمنى in 22:52 between aspiration and recitative activity changes the exact insertion channel without removing the cast-correct-firm sequence.
The rope, falling-vector, and polished-facade models are controlled analogies and should not displace the ordinary lexical readings.
